title: 中央网信办深入开展“清朗·整治AI技术滥用”专项行动第一阶段工作

policy_extraction.issuing_body: Cyberspace Administration of China (中央网信办 / 中央网络安全和信息化委员会办公室)
covered_actors: Key website and online platforms (重点网站平台, including Tencent, Weibo, Tongyi, Douyin, Alibaba, Kuaishou, MiniMax/稀宇, Xiaohongshu, Baidu)
Providers and operators of AI products including mini-programs, mobile applications, and AI agents (小程序、应用程序、智能体等AI产品)
Local AI enterprises and generative AI service operators (属地内重点企业)
Online accounts and marketing channels promoting non-compliant AI products (违规产品营销引流渠道、账号)
prohibited_practices: AI face-swapping and voice cloning that infringe public rights and interests (AI换脸拟声侵犯公众权益)
Omission of AI-generated/synthetic content labeling that misleads the public (AI内容标识缺失误导公众)
Marketing and traffic diversion for non-compliant AI products (违规产品营销引流)
Distribution of tutorials and commercial goods for non-compliant AI products (违规AI产品教程和商品)
AI-generated rumors and vulgar content (AI造谣、低俗内容)

evidence.quote: 上海网信办推动标识要求落地示范，组织开展4场法规宣贯和专题交流，覆盖企业400余家，属地内重点企业已基本完成显式标识规范上线。
evidence.source_section: 中央网信办深入开展“清朗·整治AI技术滥用”专项行动第一阶段工作
evidence.quote_en: The Shanghai Cyberspace Administration promoted the demonstration and implementation of labeling requirements, organized 4 regulatory outreach and thematic exchange sessions covering over 400 enterprises, and key enterprises within its jurisdiction have basically completed launching explicit labeling specifications.

evidence.quote:
在落实内容标识要求方面
，阿里、快手、稀宇等重点平台积极推进元数据隐式标识落地落实。
evidence.source_section: 中央网信办深入开展“清朗·整治AI技术滥用”专项行动第一阶段工作
evidence.quote_en: In implementing content labeling requirements, key platforms such as Alibaba, Kuaishou, and MiniMax actively promoted the implementation of implicit metadata labeling.

evidence.quote:
在加强训练语料管理方面
，通义平台围绕数据生命周期建立安全管理体系，在数据采集、训练、使用等阶段加强训练语料管理。
evidence.source_section: 中央网信办深入开展“清朗·整治AI技术滥用”专项行动第一阶段工作
evidence.quote_en: In strengthening training corpus management, the Tongyi platform established a security management system around the data lifecycle, strengthening training corpus management across data collection, training, and usage stages.

evidence.quote:
在防范重点领域安全风险方面
，小红书在模型后置训练阶段输入专业领域数据，提升模型对医疗、金融、未成年人等重点领域问题的理解能力。
evidence.source_section: 中央网信办深入开展“清朗·整治AI技术滥用”专项行动第一阶段工作
evidence.quote_en: In preventing security risks in key fields, Xiaohongshu fed domain-specific data during the post-training stage to improve the model's understanding of issues in key areas such as healthcare, finance, and minors.

evidence.quote:
在强化安全管理措施方面
，抖音建立“红蓝对抗”机制，模拟攻击案例，修复潜在安全漏洞，优化模型对虚假信息的识别能力。
evidence.source_section: 中央网信办深入开展“清朗·整治AI技术滥用”专项行动第一阶段工作
evidence.quote_en: In strengthening security management measures, Douyin established a 'red-blue adversarial' mechanism to simulate attack cases, fix potential security vulnerabilities, and optimize the model's ability to identify false information.

evidence.quote: 第一阶段累计处置违规小程序、应用程序、智能体等AI产品3500余款，清理违法违规信息96万余条，处置账号3700余个，各项工作取得积极进展。
evidence.source_section: 中央网信办深入开展“清朗·整治AI技术滥用”专项行动第一阶段工作
evidence.quote_en: In the first phase, a cumulative total of over 3,500 non-compliant AI products including mini-programs, apps, and agents were disposed of, over 960,000 pieces of illegal and non-compliant information were cleaned up, and over 3,700 accounts were penalized, achieving positive progress across all tasks.

evidence.quote: 江苏网信办加强统筹协调，联合省通信管理局等部门排查AI风险域名163个，封堵和取消接入域名18个。
evidence.source_section: 中央网信办深入开展“清朗·整治AI技术滥用”专项行动第一阶段工作
evidence.quote_en: The Jiangsu Cyberspace Administration strengthened overall coordination, working jointly with the Provincial Communications Administration and other departments to screen 163 high-risk AI domain names and block or revoke access to 18 domain names.

evidence.quote: 浙江网信办加大对属地AI应用和网站平台的督导力度，各平台共拦截清理各类违法违规信息及提问2550万余条。
evidence.source_section: 中央网信办深入开展“清朗·整治AI技术滥用”专项行动第一阶段工作
evidence.quote_en: The Zhejiang Cyberspace Administration increased supervisory guidance over local AI applications and website platforms, with platforms intercepting and clearing over 25.5 million pieces of illegal and non-compliant information and prompts.

evidence.quote: 天津网信办采用“人工+技术”方式，开展大模型安全监测，通报4批次14个风险问题。
evidence.source_section: 中央网信办深入开展“清朗·整治AI技术滥用”专项行动第一阶段工作
evidence.quote_en: The Tianjin Cyberspace Administration adopted a 'manual + technical' approach to conduct large-model security monitoring and issued notices on 14 risk issues across 4 batches.

enforcement_authorities: Cyberspace Administration of China (中央网信办 / 国家互联网信息办公室)
Local cyberspace administration offices (各地网信部门, including Beijing, Shanghai, Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Tianjin, and Guangdong)
Provincial Communications Administration (省通信管理局, specifically Jiangsu)
policy_extraction.penalties_summary: Phase 1 enforcement actions included the disposal/removal of over 3,500 non-compliant AI products (mini-programs, apps, and AI agents), deletion of over 960,000 pieces of illegal/non-compliant information (plus over 25.5 million intercepted/cleared by platforms in Zhejiang), disposal of over 3,700 accounts, cutting off marketing/traffic-diversion channels, and blocking/revoking access to 18 high-risk AI domains. Phase 2 will formulate formal disposal and penalty norms (处置处罚规范).
policy_extraction.implementation_notes: This document is an official supervisory progress notice published on the CAC website (2025-06-20) summarizing Phase 1 of the 'Qinglang: Rectifying Abuse of AI Technology' special campaign launched in April 2025. While not a standalone enacted statute, it carries regulatory supervision and enforcement signaling weight, detailing joint central-local enforcement, explicit and implicit (metadata) synthetic content labeling rollouts, platform-level red-blue adversarial testing and training corpus governance, and upcoming Phase 2 enforcement targeting seven prominent issues.

risk_framing.rationale_summary: The document's dominant rationale is social_stability, as it reports on the Cyberspace Administration of China's 'Qinglang' (Clean and Bright) campaign to curb AI abuse chaos, eliminate illegal and non-compliant online information, combat AI-generated rumors, disinformation, and vulgar content, and maintain a clean online information ecosystem. Consumer_public_safety is a prominent secondary frame, invoked through concerns about AI face-swapping, voice-cloning, and unlabeled synthetic content misleading the public, as well as mitigating risks in sensitive user-facing domains such as healthcare, finance, and minors. Social_stability edges out consumer_public_safety because the overarching campaign objective and next-stage priorities center on public-opinion ecosystem governance and rumor/vulgar-content containment rather than narrow product safety. Minor secondary nods appear toward fundamental_rights (infringing public rights and interests) and innovation_enablement (promoting AI for good and standardized development).

evidence_spans.quote: 下一步，中央网信办将聚焦AI造谣、低俗内容等7类突出问题，开展“清朗·整治AI技术滥用”专项行动第二阶段工作，构建技术监测体系，形成处置处罚规范，推动内容标识如期落地，形成长效工作机制，着力维护清朗网络生态，推动人工智能向善向好。
evidence_spans.source_section: 中央网信办深入开展“清朗·整治AI技术滥用”专项行动第一阶段工作
evidence_spans.quote_en: In the next step, the Cyberspace Administration of China will focus on seven prominent issues such as AI rumor-mongering and vulgar content, carry out the second phase of the 'Qinglang: Rectification of AI Technology Abuse' special campaign, build a technical monitoring system, form norms for handling and penalties, promote the on-schedule implementation of content labeling, establish a long-term working mechanism, strive to maintain a clean online ecosystem, and promote AI for good.

evidence_spans.quote: 抖音建立“红蓝对抗”机制，模拟攻击案例，修复潜在安全漏洞，优化模型对虚假信息的识别能力。
evidence_spans.source_section: 中央网信办深入开展“清朗·整治AI技术滥用”专项行动第一阶段工作
evidence_spans.quote_en: Douyin established a 'red-blue confrontation' mechanism to simulate attack cases, fix potential security vulnerabilities, and optimize the model's ability to identify false information.

evidence_spans.quote: 中央网信办聚焦AI换脸拟声侵犯公众权益、AI内容标识缺失误导公众等AI技术滥用乱象，深入推进第一阶段重点整治任务
evidence_spans.source_section: 中央网信办深入开展“清朗·整治AI技术滥用”专项行动第一阶段工作
evidence_spans.quote_en: The Cyberspace Administration of China focused on AI technology abuse chaos such as AI face-swapping and voice-cloning infringing public rights and interests and missing AI content labels misleading the public, deeply advancing the key rectification tasks of the first phase.

evidence_spans.quote: 小红书在模型后置训练阶段输入专业领域数据，提升模型对医疗、金融、未成年人等重点领域问题的理解能力。

evidence_spans.quote_en: Xiaohongshu input domain-specific professional data during the model post-training stage to improve the model's ability to understand issues in key areas such as healthcare, finance, and minors.
